The proved weak-noise law is an iterated asymptotic and does not establish a uniform joint finite-cycle scaling.

value.rationale: The new rate measures wrong-direction sorting, the operational quantity not determined by the known mean velocity. Exact angular-cycle law and an unexpected logarithmic small-diffusion divergence quantify reliability in a motivated nearly rotationally-coupled passive colloid class. The universal one-quarter coefficient and the rotational theta-series constant encode separate geometric and memory effects; these results are not an exercise in rescaling a published mean or computing an arbitrary finite example.
